readingReview.comparison: The first reader's order is the same as the script order 02-1[1,2], 02-2[1], 02-3[1,2], 02-4[1], with no skips. Concerns: (1) The 02-1 narration box breaks the top border. Its top sits on the frame line, which is a normal caption placement and confuses nothing, so this is acceptable. (2) The WELBUK PRACTICE label floats, without a clear link to the laptop. It is styled the same as the WELBUK CARE label beside the phone, and together with 'begins its Welbuk onboarding' it reads as the name of the product being set up on the laptop in the same panel, so this is acceptable. (3) The 02-2 tail reaches into the doctor's hair. The tip touches only the hair edge by the ear, so this is acceptable. (4) The 02-3 balloon and tail on Meera's hair. The balloon ends about 5 px above her crown, and the tail tip only meets the outline, so this is acceptable. (5) The WELBUK CARE label touches the kurta hem near her hand. Mapped from the art, the hand is about 25 px to the right of the label edge, and only the kurta and background are covered, so this is acceptable. (6) The 02-4 tail at her hair and the balloon close to her face. No facial feature is covered and the balloon is about 26 px from her face, so this is acceptable. (7) Bun and stethoscope continuity. She is identified by the same coat, cuffs, stud and bun, and the stethoscope is hidden only by the rear view, so this is not a lettering issue and the reading is unaffected. My r16 crown issue is resolved. No unresolved differences.
